preprocessing.body_box: largest component; fill holes; square bounding box with 5% each-side margin; zero padding
preprocessing.normalization: final LayerNorm then patch L2; uncentered
preprocessing.temperature: median nearest/second-nearest squared-distance gap over fitting patches / log(4); floor 1e-6
preprocessing.f2: median(3,1,1), nearest endpoints, one series at a time

parameters.feature_source: existing B2_448_features.npy, normalized uncentered final tokens

N1.restriction: all body-centre patches in this fit own images; no cluster-assignment restriction
N1.ties: distance, then global image index, then row-major patch index
N1.crop_center: grid cell centre transformed through recorded body crop: (cell+.5)*side/28-.5+offset; nearest integer centre=floor(value+.5)
N1.image_embedding: full BiomedCLIP encode_image with CLIP projection, L2 per crop, mean of200, L2 mean for cosine
N1.text_embedding: full BiomedCLIP encode_text normalize=True; tokenizer context256
prompts: an axial abdominal CT image showing the liver
an axial abdominal CT image showing the spleen
an axial abdominal CT image showing the kidney
an axial abdominal CT image showing the stomach
an axial abdominal CT image showing the pancreas
an axial abdominal CT image showing the gallbladder
an axial abdominal CT image showing the aorta
an axial abdominal CT image showing the vertebra
an axial abdominal CT image showing the muscle
an axial abdominal CT image showing the subcutaneous fat
an axial abdominal CT image showing the bowel
an axial abdominal CT image showing the lung
an axial abdominal CT image showing the heart
an axial abdominal CT image showing the rib
an axial abdominal CT image showing the air
N1.zscore: per prompt across8 cluster cosine similarities; population SD(ddof0); zero SD gives0
N1.selection: argmax liver zscore; ties lowest cluster ID
N1.top_prompt: argmax zscored prompt per cluster; ties declared prompt order
N1.margins: top prompt zscore minus second; raw cosine top-minus-second also recorded; liver selection zscore winner minus runner-up

N2.opening: binary opening disk radius5; native pixels; scipy default1 iteration/border0
N2.body_patch: patch centre rounded to nearest native pixel inside body mask
N2.bounding_box_coordinates: pixel-centre normalized x=(x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin), y=(y-ymin)/(ymax-ymin); singleton denominator1
N2.patch_HU: mean unwindowed HU over native pixels whose centres lie in that patch cell footprint, restricted to body mask
N2.area: each eligible patch counts one; fraction among all fit body patches
N2.centroid: area-weighted patch centroid; each patch weight1
N2.mean_HU: arithmetic mean of per-body-patch HU means, each patch weight1
N2.selection: candidate with largest area; tie lowest cluster ID; none -> abstain

parameters.N3: accept iff N1 and N2 cluster IDs equal, else abstain

scoring_plan.inductive: 4 validation patients; training16 majority/optimal fixed mapping reference
scoring_plan.reference_choice_agreement: exact singleton set equality; per-patient when LOPO mappings differ
scoring_plan.abstentions: empty masks; report fit-level and evaluated-slice rates
scoring_plan.diagnostic: per-cluster liver precision/recall on evaluated cohort; label-using, not fed back
scoring_plan.figures: same8 fixed slices; one composite per rule, columns6 fits, hard prediction contours; historical label-selected fixed slices

parameters.snapshot: Every StageA file hashed after producer exits; manifest self-hash stored separately

hash_exclusions: Only manifest itself and its detached SHA256 sidecar (self-reference). All other existing StageA files, including closed logs and library metadata, hashed.
